name: grod
description: Ask Codex about the meetings GRØD recorded on your Mac: what was decided, what is still open, and what someone said. Read-only. Needs GRØD on the same Mac with Allow MCP apps turned on.

interface.shortDescription: Ask about the meetings GRØD recorded on your Mac
interface.longDescription: Recap a week, prepare for a meeting, see what was decided and what is still open, or find what someone said and when. Codex reads GRØD's meetings on your Mac through GRØD's own read-only server, and can't change anything in GRØD.
